apps.name: FreshGuard
apps.description: FreshGuard helps you track food expiry dates, reduce waste, and save money. Features barcode scanner, local notifications, recipes matched to your stock, and savings statistics. 100% offline, no account, no cloud.
features: Barcode scanner with just-in-time camera permission
"Use by" vs "best before" date types you control
14+ recipes matched to your actual stock
